title: Mandol — where the paper and the code part ways
subtitle: Only the divergent steps are drawn. Each node states both sides; the lane says which stage of the pipeline the divergence sits in.
source: paper arXiv:2606.29778v1  ×  repo AgentCombo/Mandol @ 6d7af4f + memory-bench @ 947c136   ·   servers/mandol/verification.md §6.1 (paper↔upstream, 15 items) + §6.2 (upstream↔adapter, 15 items)
footer: memory-bench · methodology flow · paper ↔ code divergence
legend_notes: The headline mechanism error: ARCHITECTURE.md called P2's '100% L0 evidence' a retrieval ranking failure. It is not — retrieve() passes ms_names=[conv_id], and L1/L2 units are never assigned to that space in the first place (measured: 419/419 uids in conv-26's space are L0). The candidate set is structurally empty of abstractions before any scoring happens.

Two of the numbers attached to the paper don't belong to it: λ=0.6 is the code's default (the paper's Eq.3 gives λ no value at all), and the production script's κ=3.0 overrides the paper's own stated κ=2.5.

Two whole paper claims have zero code footprint anywhere in the repository: the DuckDB persistence backend (actual: rocksdict) and all three Table 2 API names (quantitative_search / search_unit / build_memory_from_raw).

The paper's headline multi-hop mechanism (selective subgraph expansion) and its 4th memory source (emotional) are both paper_only — not because they are unimplemented in the abstract, but because the exact reproduction config that produced the paper's numbers (topk_graph=0, locomo_types=[STRUCTURED]) turns them off.
